name: unified_safe_system_e2r_router_v1
cross_fit: For each held-out fold, fit router only on the other two folds.
training_target: candidate best-positive rank < baseline best-positive rank on internal router-training folds only
decision: Use candidate expert only when predicted candidate-win probability >= threshold; otherwise exact baseline fallback.

selection_gate.objective: maximize pooled Hit@10 among feasible configs, then MRR, then higher threshold, then logistic before hist_gb

next_if_selected: Freeze a brand-new salted strict double-cold confirmation protocol, retrain both experts train-only, then evaluate the frozen router once.
